rationale: The agent verified the user via email and accessed the correct account/order. It listed the recent order, identified the correct items, and excluded the espresso machine as requested, with refund to the correct card. However, it submitted the return without first obtaining explicit user confirmation of the exact changes, which violates the policy requiring confirmation before any write action. Additionally, the tool response to the return action did not clearly confirm submission, yet the agent stated it had been submitted. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
